subject: Renewal + Capacity Addendum — procurement onboarding & PO timing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <amir.patel@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Carly Nguyen <carly.nguyen@brightwellhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity addendum — procurement onboarding & PO timing

Hi Amir / Carly,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — glad to hear BrightWell is keen to expand the committed capacity for Q4. To keep timelines tight, we want to kick off procurement portal onboarding today so your procurement team can upload the PO and sign the addendum.

Quick checklist I attached: procurement-checklist.pdf (required pieces) and PO_template.xlsx (preferred format). High-level asks: 
- Signed addendum (we'll provide) or PO referencing deal BW-4821
- Billing cadence (monthly/quarterly/annual) and GL code for invoicing
- Contact for e-sig if legal needs redlines

Can you confirm who on your side will be the procurement owner and whether you need any fund/org codes from us? If okay I can loop in our Finance lead (Laura) and Sales Ops (Kimberly) so they can open the portal ticket and surface any compliance artifacts.

Proposed timeline: portal invite + evidence request by EOD tomorrow, PO in-hand by 9/10 for a 10/1 capacity uplift. If that changes, flag it here and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(aditya@redwood.com)

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf, PO_template.xlsx

From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Carly Nguyen <carly.nguyen@brightwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity addendum — procurement onboarding & PO timing

Aditya —

Appreciate the clear plan. I am the procurement lead and I’ll coordinate with Carly on our side. A few quick questions:

1) For legal redlines — do you expect a fast-track review or is the standard DPA sufficient? We typically need a copy of the proposed addendum to start review.
2) Billing cadence: we prefer net-30 monthly, is that supported for the committed seat uplift?
3) Can you provide SOC2 evidence and the DPA so our compliance team can triage?

If you can open the portal ticket that would be great — we try to route these through our AP system by vendor portal. Also, is there a single GL/expense code you recommend for software subscriptions (we can add to the PO)?

I’ll aim to have procurement's PO intent by 9/3 and a signed PO by 9/12 if everything goes smoothly.

Thanks,
Amir Patel
Procurement Manager
BrightWell Health
(amir.patel@brightwellhealth.com)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <amir.patel@brightwellhealth.com>, Carly Nguyen <carly.nguyen@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 07:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity addendum — procurement onboarding & PO timing

Hi Amir — thanks for the quick reply and the timeline. I’ve opened a procurement portal ticket (PR-99834) and invited your procurement contact; link is below. We’ve also attached the SOC2 attestation and our standard Data Processing Addendum for review so your compliance/legal team can triage.

Short answers: 
- Legal: we can provide the addendum now for review; if you need an accelerated path, please mark the ticket as "expedite" and cc lauren@redwood.com (our counsel).
- Billing cadence: net-30 monthly is supported for committed seat uplifts; Laura is cc’d to confirm invoicing setup and GL/expense code guidance.
- GL code: Commonly used code is 5102-SW (software subscriptions). If you require a different code we can include it on the invoice.

Attachments included: SOC2_attestation.pdf, DataProcessingAddendum.pdf.

Next steps I will take today:
- Populate portal ticket with the required evidence checklist and invite your AP team.
- Flag the deal for sales ops priority so we get PO routing before 9/10.
- Draft the addendum and send a DocuSign link for signature once we have PO intent.

If anything changes to your internal approval timeline, reply-all and we’ll update our runway.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
(kimberly@redwood.com)

Portal ticket: https://procure.redwood.com/tickets/PR-99834
Attachments: SOC2_attestation.pdf, DataProcessingAddendum.pdf

From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Carly Nguyen <carly.nguyen@brightwellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity addendum — procurement onboarding & PO timing

Kimberly / Aditya —

Received the SOC2 and DPA — thanks. I’ve accepted the portal invite and put PR-99834 into our queue; I also flagged it as expedite because we want the uplift effective 10/1.

We’ll aim to issue a PO intent note by 9/3 and an uploaded signed PO by 9/12. Billing cadence will be net-30 monthly; GL is likely 5401-ITS (I’ll confirm with AP and update the portal ticket). If legal needs any redline discussion I’ll loop in our counsel; otherwise we’ll try to use the standard DPA and addendum you provide.

Meeting request: can we do a 30-min handoff with AP and your billing team on Thursday 8/27 at 11am ET to walk through the portal fields? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Amir
